name: Lewis County, WA
findings: Lewis County has 200 nonprofit organizations. 87 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lewis County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Lewis County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 2 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 hobby and sports organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?
